headline: Explore Well Plugging by State
body: Browse the states CAPIT currently covers, compare high-level activity, and open detailed state pages for source definitions, recent records, and publication notes.

sections.heading: Tracking Regional Infrastructure
sections.body: A good state comparison view does more than rank totals. It must provide context by showing coverage scope, update cadence, and the specific regulatory agency behind the numbers.
